subject.title: fix(clawrouter): guard usage snapshot fetch against SSRF redirects

question: Should ClawRouter usage status intentionally stop using the generic provider HTTP proxy fetch wrapper so the SSRF guard retains exclusive dispatcher control?
rationale: The current implementation is the safer SSRF design, but it deliberately changes existing proxy-routing behavior and only an owner can confirm whether that operator contract may be narrowed.

options.title: Keep guard-owned transport
options.body: Merge the current design so DNS pinning and redirect enforcement remain centralized, accepting that the generic provider usage proxy wrapper is no longer used.

options.title: Require guarded proxy support
options.body: Revise the path to select an explicit shared guarded-fetch proxy mode with compatibility and security tests, without reintroducing fetchImpl.

recommendation.title: Keep guard-owned transport
recommendation.body: Merge the current design so DNS pinning and redirect enforcement remain centralized, accepting that the generic provider usage proxy wrapper is no longer used.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-history owner for both the ClawRouter usage path and the shared guarded-fetch implementation introduced together.
